_schema: Enforced by launch_native.py validate_contract() for --phase sft, plus release_data.verify_seed/verify_training_request. Token placeholders are FILL_*; every FILL_SHA256_64HEX must be a 64-char lowercase hex digest and every FILL_ABS_PATH must be an absolute native-Linux path with no symlinks and no '..'. This pipeline was never run natively; nothing here is approval.
_note_tokenizer_effective_sha256: 93214b2d6d9f99f2d152ce44b8dad5be7b5cdf610b96f261c458eacb7e6d54ae (must be preserved by the Linux-bound release rebuild)
_code_files_note: Must contain EVERY *.py in the trainer's directory (validate_contract requires set(trainer.parent.glob('*.py')).issubset(code)); add any file missing from the list above rather than dropping entries.

seed._note: SFT requires kind=='selected_new_cpt', selection=='best_internal_validation', a non-empty run_id that is DIFFERENT from this contract's run_id, release_id/release_sha256 of THIS release, and a parent_run receipt (phase=='cpt', completed true, clean_upstream true, matching run_id/release_id/release_sha256). 'path' is the selected & consolidated BF16 CPT weight directory; 'files' must be its EXACT inventory (config.json + weights/safetensors at minimum).

_resume_note: For a resume run, replace 'resume': null with {"path": "/training/runs/FILL_RUN_ID_SFT/FILL_RELEASE_ID_sft/checkpoint-N", "files": [ {"path": "<ABS>", "sha256": "FILL_SHA256_64HEX"} ], "complete": true, "run_identity": {"path": "/training/runs/FILL_RUN_ID_SFT/run_identity.json", "sha256": "FILL_SHA256_64HEX"}}, and launch the launcher with --resume. 'files' must be the exact inventory of checkpoint-N; three-rank optimizer + scheduler + RNG state are required.
